data.text/markdown: Optimal control problem: ||[\begin{array}{lll} \text{minimize} & s_T^T Q_T s_T + \sum_{t=1}^{T-1} s_t^T Q s_t + u_t^T R u_t \\ \text{subject to} & s_{t+1} = A s_t + B u_t, & t=1,\dots,T-1 \\ & s_{\min} \le s_t \le s_{\max}, & t=1,\dots,T \\ & u_{\min} \le u_t \le u_{\max}, & t=1,\dots,T-1 \\ & s_1 = x, \end{array}||]with optimization variable ||(z = (u_1, \dots, u_{T-1}) \in \R^{(T-1) n_u}||) and parameter ||(x \in \R^{n_s}||).

Now, consider the equivalent problem of the form: ||[\begin{array}{ll} \text{minimize} & (1/2) z^T P z + q(x)^T z \\ \text{subject to} & l(x) \le Mz \le u(x), \end{array}||]where ||(z = (u_1, \dots, u_{T-1})||). Note that for ||(t=0,\dots,T-1||), ||[ s_{t+1} = A s_t + B u_t = A^t x + \sum_{m=1}^{t} A^{t-m} B u_m = A^t x + \begin{bmatrix} A^{t-1} B & \dots & B & 0 & \dots & 0 \end{bmatrix} z. ||]In verification problem (VP) implementation, we use the optimization variable xz_stack defined as ||((x, u_1, \dots, u_{T-1}) \in \mathbf{R}^{n_s + (T-1) n_u}||).

We first simulate the ADMM algorithm on given problem instances by randomly sampling the fixed initial state parameter ||(x_\text{init}||) around its nominal value. The output will be residuals computed for each iteration ||(k=1,\ldots,K||).
